metadata.scenario: A customer reports that their therapist was not attentive during their last session. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking, how can I help you? Hi Margaret, it’s Eleanor Watson. I’ve been a client for about 14 months for post-stroke recovery. Hi Eleanor! It’s great to hear from you. How can I assist you today? Well, I wanted to talk about the physical therapy session I had three days ago. I wasn’t very happy with my therapist. I’m sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what happened? During my session, I felt like the therapist wasn’t paying much attention to my needs. It seemed like they were distracted. That’s definitely concerning, and I appreciate you bringing this to my attention. Can you elaborate on specific moments that felt off? Sure. At one point, I was struggling with an exercise and they didn’t notice until I called out for help. It felt like I was on my own. I understand how frustrating that must have been. Thank you for sharing that detail. We aim for attentive care, and I’ll make sure we address this. I just want to make sure I’m getting the best care possible. Absolutely, and your satisfaction is important to us. Would you like me to follow up with your therapist about this? Yes, I think that would be helpful. Great. I’ll also arrange for another therapist to take a look at your care plan. Would that be okay with you? That sounds good, yes. Thank you, Eleanor. I’ll coordinate that and ensure someone reaches out to your daughter as well, since she coordinates your care. Yes, please do. Also, I wanted to ask if there’s any option for additional personal care assistance? Absolutely, we can offer personal care assistance at $28 to $35 per hour. Would you be interested in scheduling that? Yes, I think it would be beneficial, especially for my daily routine. I can arrange that as well. I’ll get back to you with details on the additional care and follow-ups regarding your therapy session. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help with this. You’re very welcome, Eleanor. We’re here to support you. Have a great day! You too, bye! Goodbye!
